positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon Devices: Engineering Lead on FireTV and Fire Tablet Ads
- Scope of influence: Organization of 35 Engineers.
- Team Charter: Display Ads Expansion and Relevance on Fire TV and Fire Tablet.
- Leading the Supply Optimization Program which leverages Generative AI and Machine Learning to improve placement and ad selection, overall increasing Ad Sell-Through-Rate by [redacted]%, Ad Relevance for Ad Users, and Advertiser outcomes through increased Click-Through-Rate by [redacted]%
- Leading the Supply Expansion Program which expands Display Ads to more additional screens on Fire TV and Tablet (Home, Search, Live, Free...), additional Ad formats (Banners, Sponsored Rows), additional Geos (International Expansion), and additional Publisher Contexts (OS, App Versions..) overall increasing Ad Inventory by [redacted]%.
- Leading the Publisher Funnel Health initiative for Engineering, Product and Business Intelligence use-cases. This effort aims to improve our ability to understand the user journey, make product decisions, detect issues in production, and improve our ML training data-sets. 
- Led the expansion of Contextual Targeting and smart ad sourcing program, allowing advertisers to meet customers in high-intent placements with more relevant ads. The program also aimed to simplify ad campaign setup and creative content sourcing. This overall increased available ad inventory by [redacted]%, increased end-user relevance and Click-Through-Rate by [redacted]%, and reduced campaign setup time by [redacted]%.

Amazon Luna: Engineering Lead for Developer Experience
- Scope of influence: Organization of 20 Engineers.
- Team Charter: Cloud Gaming. 3P developer platform onboarding. Game lifecycle management.
- Led the effort to allow on demand game provisioning. This involved improving new game ingestion, compute provisioning, and game installation time by a factor of 300. This overall reduced the team's compute infrastructure bill by 55%.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineering lead for the Email Marketing Product and Buyer Segmentation as part of Commerce Seller Success.
- Led engineers and cross-functional partners through experiment setup, result analysis, privacy/legal reviews, product launch strategy and the full development lifecycle to successfully deliver more than 8 projects to create advanced targeting tooling and improve email opt-ins by 85%.
- Participated with the other team leads and cross-functional partners in product planning, roadmapping, prioritization, and staffing exercises.
- Lead the team’s oncall health and Dashboard modernization effort to improve oncall effectiveness, incident detection and mitigation and to reduce team randomization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft Teams:
- Led the engineering effort to allow cross-tenant collaboration for Microsoft Teams - Teams and Channels. (SVP Goal)

Xbox Mixer:
- Lead my organization’s effort to deprecate expensive v1 endpoints by conceiving, planning, coordinating, and executing a 3-phase-plan to roll out scenario driven v2 endpoints. This resulted in better service isolation and scale.

All of which are >99.99% availability handling thousands of requests per second.
- Planned and executed multiple service and data store migrations from legacy systems to Azure.
- Implemented and improved fraud detection and DDOS protection for owned services.
- Collaborated on founding the Gaming Early in Career squad which helps maintaining an inclusive community for early in career people within Xbox.

positions.description:

- Studying trends in report failure data and building a model to predict failure.

-Adapting several reports to the new Framework.
-Developing several internal tools such as localization tool, customer support tool and easy forms tool.
-Acting as part of an Agile team that worked mainly on platform maintenance and software support.

projects.title: Dynamic Software Update (DSU) for the Client Side of Web Applications
projects.description:
Reasearch and Development of a web application that automatically updates the client side (DOM) when the server is updated and without refreshing the page.The prototype was built using Django, HTML, Javascript and jQuery. Note that DSU is critical to any application that cannot be turned off or restarted in case of update.
P.S : Paper is in French

projects.title: Innovative project  - Righttime
projects.description:
Study of a target market needs and creation of a new product based on the market need.
The project included the conception of a whole business and marketing plan, the technical feasibility of the product, the creation of a prototype, and pitching the product to a group of experts.
The product we came up with was a social media integrated smart calendar that relies on an event suggestion engine that takes into consideration the user's preferences and previous experiences and similar users' data too (Integration of Big data).
This main use of the application is suggesting activities and events nearby that -we think- would be of interest to the user.
The interesting part of the project is that the of generation of data helps deliver a personalized experience that suits the user the most, and the more users we have, the more data which would lead to a better user experience. And the more the user uses the App, the more we know what he likes.
In addition to coming up with the idea, and participating in all phases of the project, my biggest contribution to the project was :
-Design of fully functional responsive client side of the app.
-Design of the database Architecture.
-Research on the data that we might need to collect and how to use it.
-Implementation of several parts of the website (Calendar, login, event detail, event search and search results...etc)

organizations.name: Regional Bureau of Engineering Students - Brest Region
organizations.description:
Reestablishment of the Regional Bureau of Engineering Students in the Brest Region which regrouped more than 9 Engineering-schools. Responsibilities included :
-Representation of Telecom Bretagne Students in biweekly meetings.
-Organization of bigger-scale (intra or inter region) events.
-Representation of Telecom Bretagne Students in National gatherings.
-Shaping the National decision making if it concerns Engineering students through choosing national representatives who vote on decisions made by the state.

organizations.name: Erasmus Student Network - Brest, France
organizations.description:
-Making sure international exchange students are well integrated in the student life.
-Animation of campus life and events on campus and outside it.
-Cooperation with other associations on and off the campus.
